characters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: first preview portrait for an anime-character Guess Who game category.
Create one image of Son Goku from Dragon Ball in the exact friendly stylized 3D avatar aesthetic of reference image 1.
Input images: Image 1 is the STYLE AND COMPOSITION reference (blue-haired bespectacled man on lavender). Image 2 is the CHARACTER IDENTITY reference (official Goku in orange and navy).
Render Goku alone as a polished 3D animated avatar: oversized rounded head, large expressive glossy dark eyes with visible whites, warm peach skin, rounded ears, smooth sculpted black spiky hair with Goku's unmistakable silhouette and forehead locks, thick black eyebrows, gentle confident closed-mouth smile. Recognizably adult Goku adapted to the proportions of image 1. Orange martial arts gi with dark navy undershirt.
Composition: almost square portrait, straight-on eye-level, centered symmetrical head and shoulders through upper chest, face looking at camera. Entire hair silhouette visible with comfortable top margin. Shoulders extend to lower edge, matching image 1's framing.
Scene: uniform pale lavender background matching image 1, no scenery.
Materials and lighting: soft studio lighting, smooth softly shaded toy-like skin, sculpted hair with broad strands and subtle sheen, rounded volumetric forms, soft ambient occlusion, vivid clean colors, high quality 3D rendering. Match the illustrative avatar style closely.
Constraints: use image 1 only for style, proportions, background and framing, not its personal features. Goku has no glasses, no facial hair, no bow tie, no blue hair. Do not copy image 2's action pose, frame, energy effects, aggressive expression, flat anime outlines or cel shading. No text, labels, watermark, border, other characters or props.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE square 3D avatar portrait for a Guess Who game, matching reference image 1 (approved Goku portrait) precisely in artistic style, proportions, camera distance, lighting and pale lavender background. Reference image 2 identifies the requested character only. Friendly polished animated 3D, oversized rounded head, large expressive glossy eyes, smooth rounded face, sculpted hair, soft studio lighting and ambient occlusion, vivid clean costume colors. Straight-on eye-level centered head and shoulders through upper chest, whole hair/hat/ears visible with margin. Character looks at viewer. Preserve recognizable canonical identity while adapting to this avatar style. No action pose, weapons, extra props, frames, text, labels, watermark, collage, 2D line art or cel shading. Do not copy Goku's hair, outfit, gender or facial features onto other characters. Character: Vegeta from Dragon Ball. very tall upright black hair, pronounced widow's peak, dark eyes, royal blue bodysuit and white Saiyan armor with gold abdominal panel, proud confident expression. The description specifies the chosen canonical outfit/version even if the identity reference depicts another version.
characters.editPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the Vegeta portrait provided. Preserve exactly the 3D style, character face, expression, widow's peak, tall spiky black hair shape, blue suit, white and gold armor, lighting, lavender background and square image. Change only framing: pull camera back enough so the full topmost hair tip is visible, with a clear pale lavender margin of at least 6 percent image height above the hair. Show centered head and shoulders through upper chest, shoulders reach bottom edge. Do not cut any hair. No text or borders.
